name: Revit Extensions Test Bench
tagline: Which open-source Revit add-ins actually build and run for us.

page.objective: Find out which publicly available Revit and Dynamo extensions are worth adopting, by building and deploying them rather than reading about them.
page.problem: Extension quality is impossible to judge from a repository page.
page.solution: Candidates are cloned, built against Revit 2025 and deployed; what survives is documented with its result.
